segments.text: Good afternoon. This is Aakashwani. I am Anuja Kumar with Amitya News.
The headlines. Journey of Vixit Bharat will be built on strength of India's institutes, MSMEs
and startups, says Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan. In West Bengal, campaigning ends today for Nandi
Setu scheme, aiming to transform industrial trading institutes, completes one year.

Yemen confirms strikes against Houthi-controlled areas in Sanaa and Sadda.
Houthi claims missile and drone attack targeting Aramco facilities in Riyadh.
And Asian Games 2026 to conclude today at Nagoya in Japan. India secures fourth place
in overall medal standings with a tally of 85 medals including 21 gold, 27 silver and
37 bronze.
And now the news in detail. Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan today said that the journey
of Vixit Bharat will be built on the strength of India's institutes, MSMEs and startups,
addressing the 58th Foundation Day of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India,
ICSI in New Delhi, Mr. Radhakrishnan emphasized that the nation cannot progress without gaining the trust and confidence of the investors.
The Vice President noted that India is one of the fastest growing economies in the world,
while simultaneously entering into an era of rapid technological advancements.
So, the significance of this great journey becomes even more apparent when we look at
India up today. Our country stands as one of the fastest-growing economies of the world
while simultaneously entering an era of rapid technological advancement. From Frasile 5
economy, we become the fourth largest economy and I'm sure soon we are going to be the
third largest economy of the world.
Talking about ICSI, Mr. Radhakrishnan loaded the Institute for Contributing in the Promotion
of Good Corporate Governance in the Country and described it as the global benchmark for
sustainable development.
Today is the last day of campaigning for the Nandi Gram and Regi Nagar Assembly by
elections.
The voting will take place on Tuesday, the 6th of October.
Central forces have already started arriving in both the constituencies, police and
Central Force personnel have begun route marches across villages to ensure security ahead
of polling.
Pradhan Mantri's scaling and employability transformation through upgraded ITIs, PM Setu,
has completed one year today.
The PM Setu scheme of the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship was launched
on this day last year.
The initiative seeks to strengthen industry-led governance, upgrade training infrastructure,
structure, and promote demand-driven courses in line with evolving workforce requirements
more from our correspondent.
PM Setu aims to enhance the overall quality and relevance of vocational training by transforming
government India's industrial training institute's ITIs into modern industry-aligned training
institutions.
The scheme has a total outlay of over 60,000 crore rupees comprising 30,000 crore rupees
from the center, 20,000 crore rupees from states and 10,000 crore rupees from industry.
ITIs provide vocational training to equip youth with practical skills for employment
and industry.
Under the Craftsman Training Scheme, CTS training is offered through government and
private industrial training institutes in engineering and non-engineering trades.
Its course duration varies from six months to two years, depending on the trade.
The direct trade general of training is the EPICS organization responsible for the development
and coordination of vocational training at the national level.
The total number of ITIs, including government and private, in the country has increased
to over 13,000 in 2026, from over 9,000 in 2014, indicating an increase of 42 percent.
Further, enrollment in ITIs across the country has also increased to 14.70 lakh in academic
session 2025-26 from 9.51 lakh in academic session 2014-15, indicating an increase of 54 percent.
At the national level, the ministry has constituted a national steering committee
to provide overall direction for the scheme. With Anand and Rishu, Saklein Akhtar for Akashwani
News, Delhi.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi is completing 25 years in public service, a journey defined
by the mantra of Jan Seva Se Deshseva and a relentless commitment that continues. Guided
by this vision for Seva and Sushasen, the government has been ceaselessly working
towards achieving the goal of a wixit Bharat by 2047. Through inclusive development
and social empowerment, this dedication is transforming lives. Today in our
special series we bring you an instance of how the upgradation of the Lokpriya
Gopinath International Airport in Guwahati, Assam, is making Northeast a
premier global gateway. Lokpriya Gopinath Bordeaux International Airport in Assam
has cemented its transformation from a regional transit hub into a premier
global Cadway, driving an economic and cultural renaissance across
noticed India, the massive expansion centered on the newly operational nature-inspired integrated
Terminal 2 represents a watershed milestone under the union government's Agnist policy,
officially inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on December 20, 2025 and opened for commercial
operation on February 22, 2026. This state-of-art facility is a quantum leap. The new terminal
efficiently scales up capacity to handle over 13 million passengers annually,
a fortlessly relieving, heavily congested old terminal that struggled under recent traffic.
Integrating the terminal, Prime Minister Andhra Modi said that such infrastructures along
with others create opportunities for the youth.
The infrastructure is becoming a big sign of development.
India's development journey is becoming more visible.
It is gaining more and more profits.
It is gaining more and more connectivity.
It is opening up a way to reach the local products worldwide.
And the biggest trust is that youth who are born with new opportunities.
And that's why we are seeing the progress of the people of this country.
positions at the crossroads of Southeast Asia, the upgraded hub opens efficient international
air corridor to key destinations like Bangkok, Paro and Singapore, establishing a sum as
India's vibrant eastern springboard.
Rakesh Tule, Agaswani News, Guwahati.
India Janata Party BJP today hit out at Congress leadership for maintaining silence
over the bravery of Captain Smith Machar.
talking to media in New Delhi, BJP National Spokesperson Dr. Sudhanshu Trivedi said that
while Captain Machar's bravery is being acclaimed in India, and globally, the senior leadership
of the Congress Party has remained silent on his achievement. He alleged that this silence
stems from the opposition party's fear of losing its vote bank.
The Indian Air Force today organized the second edition of the Sekhon India Air Force
Marathon in various cities across the country.
The cities include Delhi, Mumbai, Chandigarh, Gwalior, Bengaluru, Guwahati and Jodhpur.
Indian Air Force Chief, Air Chief Marshal E. B. Singh, flagged off the run at the Jawaharlal
Nehru Stadium in New Delhi.
Talking to media, Air Vice Marshal Shekhar Yadav said, the marathon is organized in
memory of Flying Officer Nirmaljeet Singh Sekhon, the only recipient of the Parambir
Chakra from the Indian Air Force.
He added that Flying Officer Nirmaljeet Singh Sekho displayed exceptional courage during
the 1971 India-Pakistan War.
Today we are celebrating the Sekho Indian Air Force Marathon.
It is the second edition.
This is in the memory of Flying Officer Nirmaljeet Singh Sekho who very bravely fought again
in the 1971 war and shot down the Pakistani sabers.
The occasion is of course the Air Force Day which is on 8th of October and this
is one of the major events which we are conducting in his memory.
This is Aakashwani giving you the news. Stay connected with AIR news. Follow us on X at

Welcome back to the midday news on Aakashwani. The India Meteorological Department or IMD
The IMD has forecast heavy rainfall at isolated places over Kerala, Mahi, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry
and Karayikal till tomorrow.
The IMD said that conditions are likely to become favorable for further withdrawal of
southwest monsoon from the remaining parts of Maratwara and Vidarb, some more parts

The Med Department said that thunderstorms and lightning conditions will continue over

External Affairs Minister Dr. Jay Shankar today met the commander of the United States
Indo-Pacific Command, Admiral Samuel Pepero.
In a social media post, Dr. Jay Shankar said they discussed ways to further strengthen
the security partnership and maritime cooperation between India and the United States in
the Indo-Pacific region.
Yemeni forces claim that Houthi fighters suffered heavy losses on key fronts in Yemen, while
Saudi Arabia has rejected a Houthi claim that Riyadh was targeted in a missile and drone
attack.
As per the media reports, Yemeni armed forces of the internationally recognized government
carried out 97 operations against Houthi reinforcements on the Tour Al-Baha and
Taiz fronts.
We have more from our West Asia correspondent.
Saudi Arabia has rejected a Houthi claim that Riyadh was targeted in Houthi missile and drone
attack. Spokesman for Saudi-led coalition called the claim misleading, saying the Houthis were
trying to project an illusory victory and divert attention from losses suffered on key
fronts in Yemen. The Houthi military claimed that they had launched missiles and drones
at Arampo in Riyadh in response to Saudi attacks on Sana and other places in Yemen.
They had claimed that they had hit targets and caused fire. Meanwhile, the armed forces
of Yemen's internationally-recognized government said they carried out 97 operations against
Houthi reinforcements in Taiz and Tural Bahá. They said 260 Houthi fighters were killed or
neutralized, and 44 military vehicles and supply assets were destroyed or disabled.
Manishiva for Akashwani News from Dubai.
In sports, the curtain falls on the Aichi Nagoya Asian Games 2026 today,
bringing more than two weeks of action-packed competition across 43 disciplines to an end.
India finishes fourth in the overall medal standings. We have a report.
The closing ceremony of the 20th Asian Games will be held at Paloma Mizuho Stadium in Nagoya,
Japan beginning at 2.30 pm IST. It will feature the traditional closing proceedings including
the grand parade of athletes, the lowering of the Asian Games flag and the formal handover
to the next host city Doha, Qatar for the 2030 edition. Proudly carrying the Indian
tricolor will be India's women's flag bearer and shooting star Neeru Dhanda. The double
gold medalist will lead India's delegation. India finishes fourth in the overall medal
standings behind China, Japan and Korea with an impressive 85 medals including 21 gold,
27 silver and 37 bronze. This is India's second-largest medal hall in Asian Games history, behind
only the record performance at Hangzhou 2023. India's women's hockey team made history
by winning gold for the first time since 1982, ending a 44-year wait while the men's
hockey team won back-to-back Asian Games titles for the first time. In archery, India's
women's recurve team secured the country's first ever Asian Games gold in the event,
while Kumkum Mohod became the first Indian women to win individual recurve gold. In golf,
Pranavi Erse became India's first women golfer to win an Asian Games gold medal. India's
boxing contingent scripted history with three gold medals, the nation's first ever
triple gold hall in single Asian Games edition.
In weightlifting, Mirabai Chanu's silver gave India its first medal in the sport since
1998. India proudly signs off from Aichi Nagoya 2026, etching another glorious chapter into
its sporting history.
Comedie Parekh, Akashwani News, Delhi.
Union Environment, Forest and Climate Change Minister Bhupendra Yadav today released two
male Great Indian Bustards into the wild at S.M. in the desert national park at Jaisalmer
in Rajasthan. In a social media post, the union minister said that this landmark success
has been made possible by the nearly decade-long, unwavering dedication of India's
scientists, researchers and ground staff. He added the release marks an important transition
in India's Great Indian Basterds Conservation Program. Mr. Iyadav also thanked Prime Minister
Narendra Modi for his support in enabling the scientific community to work towards the conservation.
And now, before we end the bulletin, the headlines once again.

Yemen confirms strikes against Houthi controlled areas in Sana and Sada.

And, Asian Games 2026 to conclude today at Nagoya in Japan, India secures fourth place

And with that, we end the midday news.
